Brazoria County runs from Houston's southern suburbs to the Gulf, anchored by Pearland with petrochemical hubs at Freeport and Lake Jackson. Growth concentrates in the north — Pearland, Manvel and Alvin along SH 288 — while the coastal half is dominated by industry, floodplain and storm-surge zones that decide which land is actually buildable.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: August 21, 2026
